blocks.orig: Toa Hotel & Spa is a beautiful modern hotel featuring 86 rooms spread across several buildings and floors, located directly on the stunning white sandy beach of Pongwe, on Zanzibar’s east coast. Overlooking the turquoise Indian Ocean, this hotel offers three swimming pools, a fitness area, a spa, a restaurant, a lobby cafe, a sundeck, and three bars – one of which is in the middle of the pool. All rooms are decorated in light soothing colours and well-appointed with comfortable beds, spacious shower rooms, a work desk, and a furnished balcony or terrace. Some rooms even feature a private plunge pool – including the honeymoon suite, which has its own swimming pool for special romantic moments.
blocks.html: Right on Pongwe's stunning white sand beach on the east coast of Zanzibar, Toa Hotel & Spa is a lovely contemporary hotel whose 86 rooms are spread over several floors and buildings. With the turquoise Indian Ocean in front of it, the hotel offers three pools, a fitness area, a spa, a restaurant, a café in the lobby, a sun deck and three bars – one of them right in the middle of the pool. The rooms all have soft, light colours and good facilities: comfortable beds, a spacious shower room, a desk to work at and a balcony or terrace with furniture. Several rooms also come with a private plunge pool – among them the honeymoon suite, whose own pool is made for special romantic moments.
